provenance_note: This repository was installed into a throwaway Kiro Crew home, trusted and enabled. Its page backend was a capture-only build (capture/demo-backend.mjs) that answers the review service's calls in-process from capture/stub_bff.mjs, which holds made-up reviews of a made-up shop. No review was sent to the real Kiro service.
data_notes: The reviews, findings and diffs come from capture/stub_bff.mjs; times are relative to the moment of capture.
